name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a natural resource company focused on mineral royalty acquisition, precious-metals exploration streaming, and project acceleration in the state of Nevada. The company holds royalty and exploration stream interests across multiple projects in Nevada and Idaho, including the Loman, Agai-Pah, and Belshazzar properties. Nevada Canyon operates as an exploration-stage royalty and streaming company within some of Nevada's highest-grade historical gold mining districts.
